note: THE PLACE TABLE: where the game's ten places are in the real city, read from the city's own data. Made by demo/tools/place-table.mjs (its header says from what): re-run it when the pinned city changes. Not edited by hand.

projects.name: Sunny Acres trailer park
projects.place: the swap-meet lane through the middle of the park; the ten pads are the ten trailers nearest it

market.name: the Jay St night market
market.place: the picnic yard among the eight stalls, on the Jay St & Washington St lot (the city block -2,1)
missing: a gun counter (the gun dealer stands at a food stall)
a fence's counter (the fence stands at a food stall)

uptown.name: Glasswall Plaza
uptown.place: the plaza's west and south edges, where the city stands its own people, and its four benches round the fountain
missing: a shop (uptown's shopkeeper stands by a plaza bench: the plaza has no kiosk or storefront of its own)

corner.name: Jay St & Washington St
corner.place: the city's own dealing-corner spots: the open apron of the night market's lot, on the corner

bar.name: DEAD AIR
bar.place: the bar's Washington St front and its Ivy St side (the city block -3,0)
missing: a way into the bar (the barkeeper stands outside at its front: the bar has no interior)

park.name: Pleasantview Park
park.place: the park's east walk, its benches and the bandstand

docks.name: Low Tide Docks
docks.place: the cargo ring behind the quay; the pier is the quay's edge at its first mooring

precinct.name: Precinct 9
precinct.place: the precinct's Central Ave wall and its Kent St front (the steps, the green lamps, the two cruisers)
missing: a desk (bail is paid and tips are sold on the front steps: the precinct has no interior)

jail.name: Iron Island
jail.place: the exercise yard: the bench by the fence, the ground by the bleachers and the weights
missing: a cell (prisoners are held in the exercise yard: the cell blocks are solid buildings)

clinic.name: St. Mercy
clinic.place: the forecourt by the main entrance: its bench, the two garden benches, the wheelchair and the IV pole
missing: a bed (patients sit on the forecourt's benches. The one gurney the city has, 4_-2·court·gurney·0, stands in the ambulance court 32 m north of the forecourt, which the city's own notes put under the EMERGENCY canopy)
